environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, Tomcat 9.0.31 with Apache Commons Collections 3.2.1 on classpath. Application runs as tomcat user with standard filesystem access. Instance has IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No deserialization filters configured. JDK 8u232.
